question.text: Annual audit of Cat III AIF valuation is mandated for:

answer.text: All assets including derivatives and marked-to-market positions

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, all assets (listed/unlisted/derivatives) must be audited annually. The Trap: Partial audit scopes are non-compliant. Cross-Exam Context: From Ch 5 and Ch 8 obligations. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Document audit trails for unlisted valuations — auditors probe these heavily.
